task: EPMCDME-15506: report each CLI analytics session's start, end and duration from its full activity range (hook times, activity columns and OTel log_events/spans) in the sessions list, session detail, users average and activity heatmap, while window membership still follows started_at.

component_scope.label: M
component_scope.affected: PostgresCliAnalyticsReader (new _activity_range helper and act CTE used by get_session_durations, get_session_cost_facts, get_session_start_times, get_session_detail_meta), LocalAnalyticsHandler (get_sessions takes duration from the reader), CLI analytics storage guide
component_scope.layers: Repository (PostgreSQL read queries), Service (analytics handler), Docs

requirements_clarity.label: S
requirements_clarity.gaps: Minor design decisions settled during implementation: the 1-day probe bound for OTel rows outside the column range, and keeping window membership on started_at instead of the widened start

technical_risk.label: M
technical_risk.risk_factors: New SQL pattern (correlated min/max probes over the weekly-partitioned log_events and spans tables), partition-pruning and query-cost concerns on the list endpoints, behaviour change in reported start/duration that the UI and Users average consume
technical_risk.mitigation: Probes bounded to one day around the column range for runtime partition pruning; read-only change with no schema migration and simple rollback; unit tests plus a live-Postgres behavioural test that skips when the database is unreachable

key_reasoning.reason: The reader gains a new range expression with correlated probes into partitioned OTel tables, bounded to a day for pruning; this is a new query pattern on list endpoints, but it is read-only and has no schema change.

Changes center on the PostgreSQL reader, which four queries share through one activity CTE, plus a small handler change and a guide update. That is two code components across the Repository and Service layers.
6 files in total: 2 source files, 1 guide, 2 extended test modules and 1 new live-Postgres test module. Most of the 384 inserted lines are tests.
